record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.context_brief: Hodge isometry from Gushel-Mukai categorical equivalence
record.original_question: Let X1 and X2 be Gushel-Mukai fourfolds, and suppose there is an equivalence Phi: Ku(X1) -> Ku(X2) between their Kuznetsov components that commutes with the degree-shift functors. Does Phi induce a Hodge isometry between the degree-four vanishing cohomology groups H^4_van(X1,Z) and H^4_van(X2,Z)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Gushel–Mukai (GM) fourfold is a smooth four-dimensional Fano variety obtained as a transverse intersection of the cone over the Grassmannian Gr(2,5) ⊂ P^9 with a linear subspace and a quadric. For such a fourfold X, the bounded derived category D^b(X) admits a semiorthogonal decomposition

  D^b(X) = ⟨Ku(X), O_X, U_X^∨, O_X(1), U_X^∨(1)⟩,

where U_X is the restriction of the tautological subbundle on Gr(2,5). The Kuznetsov component Ku(X) is a K3-type subcategory equipped with a "degree-shift" autoequivalence (an involutive autoequivalence canonically attached to the GM structure). The degree-four vanishing cohomology H^4_van(X, Z) is defined as the orthogonal complement, with respect to the intersection form, of the image of the natural map H^4(Gr(2,5), Z) → H^4(X, Z) inside H^4(X, Z); it carries a polarized Hodge structure of K3 type.

Question: Let X_1 and X_2 be two Gushel–Mukai fourfolds, and suppose Φ: Ku(X_1) → Ku(X_2) is an exact C-linear equivalence that commutes with the respective degree-shift autoequivalences. Does Φ necessarily induce a Hodge isometry

  H^4_van(X_1, Z) ≅ H^4_van(X_2, Z)?
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is established in the literature on derived categories of Gushel–Mukai varieties: an equivalence between Kuznetsov components commuting with the degree-shift functors induces a Hodge isometry on the K3-type vanishing cohomology lattices. This is treated in work of Kuznetsov–Perry and Perry–Pertusi–Zhao on GM categories.

status_evidence.title: Derived categories of Gushel–Mukai varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Special semiorthogonal component (K3 category) attached to GM fourfold, equipped with extra structure (involution/degree-shift) used in Torelli-type results.
status_evidence.claim: Framework in which equivalences of GM categories preserving extra structure give Hodge-theoretic isometries.

status_evidence.title: Stability conditions and moduli spaces for Kuznetsov components of Gushel–Mukai varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Hodge isometries induced by equivalences of Kuznetsov components of GM fourfolds.
status_evidence.claim: Equivalences of Ku(X) compatible with extra autoequivalences induce Hodge isometries on vanishing cohomology.
